Scalable Widgets puts your Scalable Capital portfolio on your home screen, so you see how it\'s doing without opening any app.
Four widgets: your portfolio\'s performance or a list of titles, each in Scalable\'s iOS look or in Material You.
Show your holdings, your watchlist or a list of exactly the titles you pick.
Widgets refresh in the background, every 30 minutes by default.
Read-only: the app can\'t trade, transfer money or change anything in your account.
Your login stays on this phone
The app signs in the same way as Scalable\'s official command-line tool (CLI), and keeps everything it needs locally and encrypted.
You sign in on Scalable\'s own website and, if asked, approve it in the Scalable app. This app never sees your password.

Each login is bound to a signing key that is created inside the Android Keystore, on most phones in the secure hardware (TEE or StrongBox). The key can be used but never read out, not even by this app, so a copied token is useless on another device.
The session tokens are encrypted with a second Keystore key (AES-256) before they are saved, and they are excluded from backups.
No servers of mine in between: the app talks to Scalable and, only if you allow it, to Google Firebase for usage statistics and crash reports. No ads and no advertising ID.
Scalable ends the session after seven days at most. Signing out in the app revokes it right away.
